findings.label: Fail-open token check
findings.summary: if (INTERNAL_TOKEN && ...) skips auth when INTERNAL_RECORD_TOKEN is unset. Any caller can write arbitrary earnings. Fix: invert to if (!INTERNAL_TOKEN || req.headers['x-internal-token'] !== INTERNAL_TOKEN).

findings.label: Auto-create on first read inflates KV
findings.summary: user-stats.js persists a blank 4 KB profile for every visitor on first poll. Remove kv.set from the GET handler; create the record only in record-survey.js when the first postback arrives.

findings.label: Hardcoded production URL
findings.summary: VERCEL_BASE_URL = 'https://nisi-cash.vercel.app' in script.js breaks the dashboard on preview/staging/local deployments. Replace with window.location.origin.

findings.label: pending→completed uses prevAmount, discards payout adjustment
findings.summary: When a completion postback carries a higher amount than the pending postback, the user is credited the lower figure. Confirm whether CPX/Wannads ever adjust payout at completion; if so, use amt instead of prevAmount.
